chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah عليه السلام using a toothpick, so I looked at him. He said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used a toothpick, and it makes the mouth pleasant.”

key_terms.رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, cited as the model for this practice
key_terms.يَتَخَلَّلُ: he cleaned between the teeth with a toothpick or similar implement
key_terms.يُطَيِّبُ: it makes pleasant, fresh, or wholesome

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about using a toothpick and cleaning the mouth?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام practiced cleaning between the teeth and linked it directly to the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It highlights oral cleanliness as a refined etiquette and a Prophetic practice that beautifies and freshens the mouth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4260 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih who said:

I saw Abu Abdillah (as) using a toothpick, so I looked at him.
Imam (as) said: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) used a toothpick, and it purifies the mouth."
